load_pretrained_state_dict: load a pretrained model state dict into a trainer with optimizer and lr scheduler
create_checkpoint_instance: create a Checkpoint object from a trainer to manage saving and loading model checkpoints
save_checkpoint: save the current trainer model, optimizer, and lr scheduler state to a checkpoint file
resume_from_checkpoint: resume training by loading the last checkpoint or a specified checkpoint file
finalize_checkpoint: finalize training by saving the final model state dict to a .pth file
